written_after: the cost estimate maker_entry_estimate.json was computed (fill rates, adverse selection, per-side costs) and BEFORE any DEV re-evaluation of the 20 fast configs or the 33 R9 candidates was run
why: The like-for-like market-order side cost this method measures (5.2-7.8bp per side incl. 5bp fee, worst symbol DOT 7.8) is about half of the published 13.3bp per side used by the DEV tools (worst-symbol 90% quantile half spread 7.27bp + latency move + impact). Substituting the raw limit-order cost for the published cost would mix 'limit instead of market' with 'a less conservative cost framework'. That would loosen a criterion by the back door, which this project forbids.
data_deviation: The 2026-10-27 aggTrades daily file is not yet published on the public mirror, so the tape and every simulated order cover the snapshots up to the end of 2026-10-26 UTC (about 3.4 days, not 4); the method is otherwise unchanged. Orders need the full 600 s tape window after them.

amendment.matched_ratio: r_X = max over symbols of C_X(symbol) / taker_side(symbol), from the same simulation (rule QUEUE, timeout 120 s, latency 0.5 s, maker fee 2bp, pooled), X in {chase, abandon}. The taker_side is the market order side cost of this same method (fee 5bp + vwap offset + latency drift).

rows.R_A_matched: entry side = published measured side cost x r_abandon, exit side = published side cost (limit entry with abandon, market exit)
rows.R_B_matched: both sides = published measured side cost x r_chase (PRIMARY ROW, replaces the raw R_B of the prereg as the verdict row)
rows.R_C_matched: entry side x r_chase, exit side unchanged
rows.R_B_matched_stress: same with the ratio taken in the stress slice (top tercile of trailing 5 minute range), replaces 'volume_scaled' in the fast short condition (e) and is the robustness check of the R9 entry bar
rows.R_B_raw: raw limit cost from this method, both sides (descriptive only: NOT comparable with the published cost, shown to make the framework gap visible)
rows.R_mkt_own: market orders at the own-method side cost (worst symbol), descriptive control for the framework gap

amendment.criteria: unchanged. Fast short flag rules (a)-(f) of ADR 0045 and the R9 entry bar S1 SR >= 1.0 with >= 5 of 33 are used as they are; the primary row replaces 'measured', the stress row replaces 'volume_scaled'.
amendment.trials: 53 evaluations (20 + 33) under the primary row, as in the prereg.
